danger.modalBody: The account becomes inaccessible and your profile data is anonymised. This cannot be undone.
danger.keepsSubscriptions: The subscription history is retained, as required by legal and accounting obligations.
danger.keepsInvoices: Issued invoices are retained, for the same reason.
danger.keepsTerms: The record of which version of the Terms you accepted, and when, is kept — it is the proof of the contract.
danger.anonymizes: Name, phone, tax number, photo and preferences are anonymised.
danger.archivesListings: Published listings are taken down as archived; they are not deleted.
danger.legalNote: Identifiers are also retained in irreversible form, to prevent the same person from repeatedly benefiting from limited offers. The legal basis and the retention period are set out in the Terms and Conditions.

campaigns.title: Campaigns
campaigns.subtitle: The marketing email builder, by sequence.
campaigns.empty: No campaigns yet. Create the first one.
campaigns.audienceCount: {count, plural, =0 {nobody receives it} one {# person receives it} other {# people receive it}}
campaigns.audienceConsentNote: Zero is the right answer: campaigns to registered users are opt-in and sign-up does not collect consent yet.
campaigns.senderHint: The mailbox is who signs it, not how it travels.
campaigns.preheaderHint: The line mail clients show next to the subject.
campaigns.delayHint: Days after the previous email in the sequence.
campaigns.backgroundNote: Hexadecimal, not a token: a mail client has none of the design system's colour variables.
campaigns.canvasEmpty: This email has no blocks yet. Pick one on the left.
campaigns.exportFailed: The HTML could not be exported.
campaigns.sendPendingNote: Scheduling sets the status and the date; what fires at that moment is P10-09. Sending puts the campaign in the mail worker's queue, which delivers in batches — the status becomes Sent when the last recipient goes out.
campaigns.footerLocked: The footer cannot be deleted or duplicated: it carries the unsubscribe link.
campaigns.logoFallbackNote: With no image the brand goes as text: the project's logos are SVG, which mail clients do not render.
campaigns.imageAltHint: In an email, blocked images are the normal case — this is what gets read.
campaigns.propertyPhotoNote: The photo is attached at send time: covers live in a private bucket and a signed URL expires.
campaigns.dividerNote: A line between blocks. No alignment and no fields.
campaigns.signatureReadOnlyNote: Signatures are edited in Support; here you only pick the mailbox.
campaigns.footerHint: What appears above the unsubscribe link.
campaigns.footerUnsubscribeNote: The unsubscribe link is added at send time, with each recipient's own token.
campaigns.sendHint: Puts the campaign into sending. The mail worker takes it from there.
campaigns.sendConfirm: Send “{name}”? A campaign goes out once — there is no calling it back.
campaigns.sendTestHint: Sends what is saved to an address of your choice.
campaigns.sendTestNeedsSave: Save the email before sending a test.
campaigns.sendTestPrompt: Address to send the test to
campaigns.receiptsNote: The large number is distinct people; the total counts every event. Opens depend on the mail client loading images, so they are always a floor and not an exact figure.
campaigns.scheduleFailed: The send scheduled for {when} failed {attempts, plural, one {# time} other {# times}} and is no longer being retried. Fix what is missing and schedule it again.

metrics.downloadFailed: The report could not be composed.
metrics.saveHint: The same report, in the internal Cloud, under "Campaign reports".
metrics.emptyHint: Metrics appear here as soon as the first campaign goes out.
metrics.noReceiptsNote: There are sent campaigns and no receipts received. Until the Resend webhook points at the mail worker and RESEND_WEBHOOK_SECRET is set, these numbers stay at zero — which does not mean the emails did not arrive. See doc 09, Deliverability.
